nextAuthorizedStep.summary: The operator reviews the continuity system (CONTINUITY-1) and either explicitly authorizes a next phase or asks for corrections. Until then no implementation work is authorized.

doNotStart.rule: After CONTINUITY-1 is built and validated: STOP. These are introduced later only through the Active Phase Contract, after the continuity system passes audit.
